name: media-transcriber
title: Whisper Transcriber: Audio, Video & Podcast Speech to Text
description: Transcribe audio and video files or podcast RSS feeds with Whisper: full text, timestamped segments, SRT and VTT subtitles, language detection and RAG chunks. Direct file URLs or uploads (not YouTube links). New-episodes mode. No API key. From $0.008 per audio minute.
